IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Lovick, Clements, Ericks, O'Brien and Newhouse

Bill.BriefDescription: Raising the mandatory retirement age for members of the Washington state patrol retirement system.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to raising the mandatory retirement age for membersof the Washington state patrol retirement system; and amending RCW43.43.250.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.43.250 and 1982 1st ex.s. c 52 s 26 are eachamended to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any member who has attained the age of sixtyone years shall beretired on the first day of the calendar month next succeeding that inwhich said member shall have attained the age of sixty: PROVIDED, Thatthe requirement to retire at age sixtyone shall not apply to a memberserving as chief of the Washington state patrol. (2) Any member who has completed twentyfive years of creditedservice or has attained the age of fiftyfive may apply to retire asprovided in RCW 43.43.260, by completing and submitting an applicationform to the department, setting forth at what time the member desiresto be retired.
